intent: Implements the tpunit++ micro test framework's runner: fixture registration, multithreaded execution with name filtering, before/after hooks, pass/fail bookkeeping, and console output.

objects.name: tpunit::_TestFixture
objects.role: fixture base; registers itself on construction and implements the whole run loop, per-class and per-test threading, method dispatch with exception trapping, and float-equality helpers

objects.name: tpunit::_TestFixture::method
objects.role: one registered before/after/test callback; linked-list node

objects.name: tpunit::_TestFixture::stats
objects.role: global pass/fail counters and failure-name set

objects.name: tpunit::Tests::run
objects.role: public entry points that call into _TestFixture::tpunit_detail_do_run

objects.name: tpunit::tpunit_break_check_line
objects.role: keeps short-form dot output readable when a verbose log line interrupts it

name_fit.note: It's the vendored micro-framework's implementation file; the ++ suffix is unusual but recognizable.

location_fit.note: Fits; kept under test/lib with the rest of the test infrastructure.

naming_quality.note: registerTests taking 70 individually numbered method* parameters (m0..m69) is a design wart inherited from the upstream framework, not a naming defect, but it stands out.
